evidence.notes: WorkerConfig loads env configuration and applies design spec defaults
Pure trigger evaluator fires Hestia state and watchdog breach triggers
BackendClient implements DiagnosisBackend for fleet checks, breaches, dedup checks, crop targets, and alert writing
DiagnosticModel trait and parse_diagnosis strictly validate reason codes and confidence bounds with unexplained_anomaly fallback
AnthropicDiagnosticModel executes tool calling with token, round trip, and time budgets, enforcing device scoping and query clamping
Orchestrator run_diagnosis skips model on recent alert dedup and falls back to unexplained_anomaly on model errors
Fleet tick run_fleet_tick executes bounded-concurrency diagnoses across triggered fleet devices
